guideTitle: The Best Compact Docking Stations for Small Desks
metaTitle: Best Compact Docking Stations for Small Desks (2026)
metaDescription: We compared compact laptop docks for small desks on size, display outputs, ports and charging, from a slim UGREEN hub to detachable and Mac-focused docks.
introParagraphs: On a small desk, a dock should add ports without adding clutter. Compact bar-shaped hubs sit beside the laptop or tuck under a stand; larger docks with power bricks take more space but can charge the laptop themselves.

The other questions are the usual ones: how many monitors your laptop can actually drive through the dock (base MacBooks and many Windows laptops support fewer than a dock's outputs suggest), whether you need Ethernet or a card reader, and whether the dock passes through your charger's power or has its own.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $27 to $150 at the time of writing.

ugreen-revodok-pro-210-10-in-1.summary: A compact 10-in-1 hub with dual HDMI, Ethernet, SD/TF and 100W pass-through.
ugreen-revodok-pro-210-10-in-1.description:
The UGREEN Revodok Pro 210 is the sensible choice for a small desk: a compact 10-in-1 hub with two HDMI outputs listed for 4K 60Hz, gigabit Ethernet, an SD/TF reader, 5Gbps USB and 100W pass-through, for about $40 at the time of writing.

It is small enough to sit beside the laptop. Dual extended displays depend on your laptop.
ugreen-revodok-pro-210-10-in-1.skipIf: You want the slimmest hub; the 7-in-1 is smaller.

ugreen-revodok-pro-7-in-1.summary: A thin aluminum 7-in-1 hub with dual 4K HDMI, 10Gbps data and 100W pass-through.
ugreen-revodok-pro-7-in-1.description:
The UGREEN 7-in-1 is the slimmest option, thin enough to slide under a laptop stand, with two HDMI outputs listed for 4K 60Hz, 10Gbps USB and 100W pass-through, for about $27 at the time of writing.

It drops Ethernet and the card reader.
ugreen-revodok-pro-7-in-1.skipIf: You need Ethernet; the 10-in-1 has it.

anker-nano-13-in-1-detachable.summary: A 13-in-1 dock that splits into a core dock and a 6-in-1 hub, with up to three displays.
anker-nano-13-in-1-detachable.description:
The Anker Nano 13-in-1 splits into a compact core and a detachable 6-in-1 hub, so you can keep only what you use on the desk. It supports up to three displays (two HDMI and a DisplayPort), with 10Gbps USB-C, three USB-A, SD/TF, Ethernet and up to 100W power delivery.

It costs about $120 at the time of writing, and three displays depend on your laptop.
anker-nano-13-in-1-detachable.skipIf: You need one or two monitors; the UGREEN hubs cost far less.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5.summary: HP's 11-in-1 G5 business dock with front-facing ports.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5.description:
The HP G5 is a compact business dock with front-facing ports for everyday connections, listed for USB-C and Thunderbolt laptops, with remote management features for IT, for about $98 at the time of writing.

It uses its own power supply, which takes a little extra space.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5.bestFor: Small office desks with managed laptops.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5.skipIf: You want the smallest footprint; a UGREEN hub is smaller.

pulwtop-macbook-pro-dock.summary: A compact dual-HDMI dock aimed at MacBooks, with Ethernet and SD/TF.
pulwtop-macbook-pro-dock.description:
The PULWTOP is aimed at MacBook Pro and Air owners who want two monitors: dual HDMI at 4K 60Hz, 10Gbps USB, Ethernet, SD/TF and power delivery, for about $70 at the time of writing.

It uses DisplayLink to add a second display on MacBooks with a one-display limit, so the DisplayLink driver is required.
pulwtop-macbook-pro-dock.bestFor: MacBook owners who need two screens on a small desk.
pulwtop-macbook-pro-dock.skipIf: Your laptop drives two screens natively; a UGREEN hub avoids the driver.

anker-8-in-1-dual-monitor.summary: An 8-in-1 hub with two HDMI ports, Ethernet, SD and 85W pass-through.
anker-8-in-1-dual-monitor.description:
The Anker 8-in-1 is a compact bar-shaped hub with two HDMI outputs, gigabit Ethernet, an SD reader and 85W pass-through, for about $54 at the time of writing.

The UGREEN 10-in-1 lists similar features for less.
anker-8-in-1-dual-monitor.skipIf: Price matters; the UGREEN 10-in-1 is cheaper.

acer-11-in-1-3-monitor.summary: An Acer 11-in-1 with three outputs (DisplayPort up to 8K, HDMI 4K 60Hz), 100W and Ethernet.
acer-11-in-1-3-monitor.description:
The Acer 11-in-1 lists three monitor outputs, a DisplayPort rated up to 8K and HDMI at 4K 60Hz, with 10Gbps data, 100W power delivery, SD/TF and gigabit Ethernet, for about $50 at the time of writing.

Three extended displays depend on your laptop supporting them; Macs generally will not extend across multiple outputs of a hub like this.
pros: Three outputs at a low price
acer-11-in-1-3-monitor.bestFor: Windows laptops that support three displays.
acer-11-in-1-3-monitor.skipIf: You use a MacBook; choose a DisplayLink dock.

tobenone-18-in-2-mac-dock.summary: A TobenONE DisplayLink dock with a 150W adapter, dual 4K, 2.5GbE and seven USB ports.
tobenone-18-in-2-mac-dock.description:
The TobenONE 18-in-2 is the fuller Mac dock: a 150W power adapter, dual 4K 60Hz via DisplayLink, 2.5G Ethernet, seven USB ports and an SD 4.0 reader, for about $150 at the time of writing.

It is larger than the hubs and needs its adapter, which takes more space on a small desk.
tobenone-18-in-2-mac-dock.bestFor: MacBook desks that want a full dock.
tobenone-18-in-2-mac-dock.skipIf: Space is very tight; the PULWTOP is smaller.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Bar-shaped hubs (UGREEN, Anker) take the least space; docks with power bricks take more.
Check your laptop's external display support. MacBooks with a one-display limit need DisplayLink docks (PULWTOP, TobenONE) for two.
Ethernet and card readers are the usual extras to check for.
Hubs pass through your charger; the HP and TobenONE supply their own power.

faq.q: Can a compact hub run two monitors?
faq.a: If your laptop supports two external displays over USB-C. Base MacBooks generally need a DisplayLink dock for a second screen.

faq.q: Will a hub charge my laptop?
faq.a: Hubs pass through your charger's power up to their rated wattage.

faq.q: Where should a dock go on a small desk?
faq.a: A slim hub can sit under a laptop stand or behind the monitor, keeping the surface clear.

bottomLine: For most small desks, the UGREEN Revodok Pro 210 packs the essentials into a small body, and the UGREEN 7-in-1 is the slimmest, cheapest option.

MacBook owners who need two screens should look at the PULWTOP, or the TobenONE for a full dock. The Acer suits Windows laptops that support three displays, and the Anker Nano 13-in-1 is the modular choice.
